description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named GatewayDiscoveryDebugLogView, which displays debug logs related to gateway discovery processes. It includes UI elements to show logs, enable copying logs to clipboard, and manage display based on debug log state.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryDebugLogView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view to display and copy gateway discovery debug logs.

methods.name: formattedLog
methods.description: Formats the debug logs into a single string for copying.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a time string using HH:mm:ss format.

methods.name: formatISO
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO8601 string with fractional seconds.
